source_url_mapping.title: Donald Trump Woos Wisconsin With Jobs-and-Economy Pitch
source_url_mapping.support_note: NBC News reports the April 2, 2016 Eau Claire campaign appearance as Trump’s third and final Wisconsin campaign stop that Saturday; says he trailed Ted Cruz by double digits before Tuesday’s primary; describes his jobs-and-economy pitch and foreign-policy turn; quotes Trump’s response to President Obama’s comments and his subsequent pivot to Japan, South Korea, and North Korea. The reported nuclear comparison is to Obama.
source_url_mapping.uncertainty: The report verifies the reported utterance and context, not the truth of Trump’s boast, a comparative assessment of expertise, the claim that he knew more than anyone, or a causal claim about policy or expert advice. It does not support the previous long-description detail naming Memorial High School, which was removed.

unsupported_claims_preserved_verbatim: That Trump said he knew more about nuclear weapons than anyone.
That the boast establishes expertise or that he bypassed expert guidance because of it.
source_grounding_review: Directly fetched the mapped NBC News article (HTTP 200). Its article text supports the expanded campaign context and wording; the prior Memorial High School detail does not appear in this mapped source and was removed.
